{{Quote|I'm looking for Shendo. I was told he might be here?<br />No, he's not around, as usual. He's off goofing around as always. I don't think I've ever seen him without a Sunburn in his hand and spice on his breath.|A spacer and Pannaqa|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Shendo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was known for being quite difficult to deal with.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Shendo.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Shendo]]
Shendo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
